definitions: If the current situation or behavior continues, there will be negative consequences.
Used to express concern about the future if present trends persist.
examples: If we keep going like this, we'll never finish on time.
The team is losing every game; if we keep going like this, we'll be relegated.
If we keep going like this, our resources will be depleted.
lemma: if we keep going like this
source: if we keep going like this
